definitions.explanation: A spoken account of events or a narrative.
An exchange of ideas through speech.

notes:
{話|はなし} is an extremely common noun with three main meanings: story/tale, conversation, and topic/matter.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {話|はなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have a conversation
- {話|はなし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to listen to a story/what someone says
- {話|はなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: I have something to discuss
- {話|はなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: long-winded

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {話|はなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧: good at talking
- {話|はなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧: to get along well in conversation
- {話|はなし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: to change the subject
- {話|はなし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧: out of the question, absurd

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧: old tale, folklore
- ⟦{世間話|せけんばなし}→世間話：07021_sekenbanashi⟧: small talk, chitchat
- ⟦{身の上話|みのうえばなし}→身の上話：19137_minouebanashi⟧: one's life story
